verses.original: קִרְב֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים הַקְשִׁ֑יבוּ תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ תֵּבֵ֖ל וְכָל־ צֶאֱצָאֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: qir·ḇū ḡō·w·yim liš·mō·a‘ ū·lə·’um·mîm haq·šî·ḇū tiš·ma‘ hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mə·lō·’āh tê·ḇêl wə·ḵāl ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·hā
verses.literal: Come near O nations to listen pay attention O peoples Let the earth hear and all that fills it the world and all that springs from it
verses.literalPt: Chegai-vos, nações, para ouvir, e escutai, povos; ouça a terra e a sua plenitude, o mundo e tudo o que ele produz.

verses.original: כִּ֣י קֶ֤צֶף לַֽיהוָה֙ עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֵמָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ צְבָאָ֑ם הֶחֱרִימָ֖ם נְתָנָ֥ם לַטָּֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: kî qe·ṣep̄ Yah·weh ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim wə·ḥê·māh ‘al- kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’ām he·ḥĕ·rî·mām nə·ṯā·nām laṭ·ṭā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: The LORD is angry with . . . all . . . the nations and furious with all their armies He will devote them to destruction He will give them over to slaughter
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová tem indignação contra todas as nações e furor contra todo o seu exército; tem-nas destruído totalmente, tem-nas entregue à matança.

verses.original: וְחַלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יֻשְׁלָ֔כוּ וּפִגְרֵיהֶ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה בָאְשָׁ֑ם וְנָמַ֥סּוּ הָרִ֖ים מִדָּמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥal·lê·hem yuš·lā·ḵū ū·p̄iḡ·rê·hem ya·‘ă·leh ḇā·’ə·šām wə·nā·mas·sū hā·rîm mid·dā·mām
verses.literal: Their slain will be left unburied and the stench of their corpses will rise the mountains will flow with their blood
verses.literalPt: Os seus mortos também serão arrojados, subirá o mau cheiro dos seus cadáveres, e os montes serão derretidos pelo seu sangue.

verses.original: וְנָמַ֙קּוּ֙ כָּל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָגֹ֥לּוּ כַסֵּ֖פֶר הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכָל־ צְבָאָ֣ם יִבּ֔וֹל כִּנְבֹ֤ל עָלֶה֙ מִגֶּ֔פֶן וּכְנֹבֶ֖לֶת מִתְּאֵנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·maq·qū kāl- ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·ma·yim wə·nā·ḡōl·lū ḵas·sê·p̄er haš·šā·mā·yim wə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā·’ām yib·bō·wl kin·ḇōl ‘ā·leh mig·ge·p̄en ū·ḵə·nō·ḇe·leṯ mit·tə·’ê·nāh
verses.literal: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved The skies will be rolled up like a scroll and all their stars . . . will fall like withered leaves from the vine like foliage from the fig tree
verses.literalPt: Todo o exército do céu dissolverá, e os céus se enrolarão como um livro; todo o seu exército desvanecerá, como cai a folha da vide e da figueira.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רִוְּתָ֥ה בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם חַרְבִּ֑י הִנֵּה֙ עַל־ אֱד֣וֹם תֵּרֵ֔ד וְעַל־ עַ֥ם חֶרְמִ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kî- riw·wə·ṯāh ḇaš·šā·ma·yim ḥar·bî hin·nêh ‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm tê·rêḏ wə·‘al- ‘am ḥer·mî lə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens then it will come down upon Edom upon the people I have devoted to destruction
verses.literalPt: Pois a minha espada se tem embriagado no céu; eis que descerá sobre Edom e sobre o povo devotado por mim à destruição, para exercer juízo.

verses.original: חֶ֣רֶב לַיהוָ֞ה מָלְאָ֥ה דָם֙ הֻדַּ֣שְׁנָה מֵחֵ֔לֶב מִדַּ֤ם כָּרִים֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים מֵחֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת אֵילִ֑ים כִּ֣י זֶ֤בַח לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּבָצְרָ֔ה וְטֶ֥בַח גָּד֖וֹל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ Yah·weh mā·lə·’āh ḏām hud·daš·nāh mê·ḥê·leḇ mid·dam kā·rîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm mê·ḥê·leḇ kil·yō·wṯ ’ê·lîm kî ze·ḇaḥ Yah·weh bə·ḇā·ṣə·rāh wə·ṭe·ḇaḥ gā·ḏō·wl bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood It drips with fat with the blood of lambs and goats with the fat of the kidneys of rams For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah a great slaughter in the land of Edom
verses.literalPt: A espada de Jeová está cheia de sangue, está engrossada com gordura, com o sangue de cordeiros e de bodes, com a gordura dos rins de carneiros; porque Jeová tem sacrifício em Bozra e grande matança na terra de Edom.

verses.original: וְיָרְד֤וּ רְאֵמִים֙ עִמָּ֔ם וּפָרִ֖ים עִם־ אַבִּירִ֑ים וְרִוְּתָ֤ה אַרְצָם֙ מִדָּ֔ם וַעֲפָרָ֖ם מֵחֵ֥לֶב יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·rə·ḏū rə·’ê·mîm ‘im·mām ū·p̄ā·rîm ‘im- ’ab·bî·rîm wə·riw·wə·ṯāh ’ar·ṣām mid·dām wa·‘ă·p̄ā·rām mê·ḥê·leḇ yə·ḏuš·šān
verses.literal: And the wild oxen will fall with them the young bulls with the strong ones Their land will be drenched with blood and their soil will be soaked with fat
verses.literalPt: Descerão com eles os bois monteses e os novilhos com os touros; a sua terra embriagar-se-á de sangue, e o seu pó se engrossará de gordura.

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה שְׁנַ֥ת שִׁלּוּמִ֖ים לְרִ֥יב צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·wm nā·qām Yah·weh šə·naṯ šil·lū·mîm lə·rîḇ ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: For the LORD has a day of vengeance a year of recompense for the cause of Zion
verses.literalPt: Pois é o dia da vingança de Jeová e o ano da retribuição na controvérsia de Sião.

verses.original: וְנֶהֶפְכ֤וּ נְחָלֶ֙יהָ֙ לְזֶ֔פֶת וַעֲפָרָ֖הּ לְגָפְרִ֑ית וְהָיְתָ֣ה אַרְצָ֔הּ לְזֶ֖פֶת בֹּעֵרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·hep̄·ḵū nə·ḥā·le·hā lə·ze·p̄eṯ wa·‘ă·p̄ā·rāh lə·ḡā·p̄ə·rîṯ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’ar·ṣāh lə·ze·p̄eṯ bō·‘ê·rāh
verses.literal: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar and her soil to sulfur her land will become a blazing pitch
verses.literalPt: Converter-se-ão em pez as suas torrentes, e o seu pó, em enxofre, a sua terra tornar-se-á em pez ardente.

verses.original: לַ֤יְלָה וְיוֹמָם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה לְעוֹלָ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה עֲשָׁנָ֑הּ מִדּ֤וֹר לָדוֹר֙ תֶּחֱרָ֔ב לְנֵ֣צַח נְצָחִ֔ים אֵ֥ין עֹבֵ֖ר בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lay·lāh wə·yō·w·mām lō ṯiḵ·beh lə·‘ō·w·lām ya·‘ă·leh ‘ă·šā·nāh mid·dō·wr lā·ḏō·wr te·ḥĕ·rāḇ lə·nê·ṣaḥ nə·ṣā·ḥîm ’ên ‘ō·ḇêr bāh
verses.literal: It will not be quenched day or night Its smoke will ascend forever From generation to generation it will lie desolate no one will ever again . . . pass through it
verses.literalPt: Nem de noite nem de dia, se apagará; o seu fumo subirá para sempre; de geração em geração, ficará deserta; pelos séculos dos séculos, ninguém por ela passará.

verses.original: וִירֵשׁ֙וּהָ֙ קָאַ֣ת וְקִפּ֔וֹד וְיַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְעֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְנָטָ֥ה עָלֶ֛יהָ קַֽו־ תֹ֖הוּ וְאַבְנֵי־ בֹֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·rê·šū·hā qā·’aṯ wə·qip·pō·wḏ wə·yan·šō·wp̄ wə·‘ō·rêḇ yiš·kə·nū- ḇāh wə·nā·ṭāh ‘ā·le·hā qaw- ṯō·hū wə·’aḇ·nê- ḇō·hū
verses.literal: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it and the great owl and raven will dwell in it The LORD will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction
verses.literalPt: Mas o pelicano e o ouriço a possuirão; o bufo e o corvo nela habitarão. Estender-se-á sobre ela a regra de confusão e o prumo de vaidade.

verses.original: חֹרֶ֥יהָ וְאֵֽין־ שָׁ֖ם מְלוּכָ֣ה יִקְרָ֑אוּ וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֖יהָ יִ֥הְיוּ אָֽפֶס׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·re·hā wə·’ên- šām mə·lū·ḵāh yiq·rā·’ū wə·ḵāl śā·re·hā yih·yū ’ā·p̄es
verses.literal: No . . . nobles will be left to proclaim a king and all her princes will come to nothing
verses.literalPt: Os seus nobres serão chamados ao reino, porém não haverá nenhum; e todos os seus príncipes serão reduzidos a nada.

verses.original: וְעָלְתָ֤ה אַרְמְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סִירִ֔ים קִמּ֥וֹשׂ וָח֖וֹחַ בְּמִבְצָרֶ֑יהָ וְהָיְתָה֙ נְוֵ֣ה תַנִּ֔ים חָצִ֖יר לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·lə·ṯāh ’ar·mə·nō·ṯe·hā sî·rîm qim·mō·wś wā·ḥō·w·aḥ bə·miḇ·ṣā·re·hā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh nə·wêh ṯan·nîm ḥā·ṣîr liḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns her fortresses with thistles and briers She will become a haunt for jackals an abode for ostriches
verses.literalPt: Nascerão espinhos nos seus palácios, urtigas e cardos, nas suas fortalezas. Será uma habitação de chacais, pastagem de avestruzes.

verses.original: וּפָגְשׁ֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת־ אִיִּ֔ים וְשָׂעִ֖יר עַל־ רֵעֵ֣הוּ יִקְרָ֑א אַךְ־ שָׁם֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעָה לִּילִ֔ית וּמָצְאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ מָנֽוֹחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·ḡə·šū ṣî·yîm ’eṯ- ’î·yîm wə·śā·‘îr ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū yiq·rā ’aḵ- šām hir·gî·‘āh lî·lîṯ ū·mā·ṣə·’āh lāh mā·nō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas and one wild goat will call to another There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose
verses.literalPt: As feras do deserto se encontrarão com as hienas, e os sátiros clamarão uns para os outros; a bruxa se pousará ali e achará para si um lugar de descanso.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה קִנְּנָ֤ה קִפּוֹז֙ וַתְּמַלֵּ֔ט וּבָקְעָ֖ה וְדָגְרָ֣ה בְצִלָּ֑הּ אַךְ־ שָׁ֛ם נִקְבְּצ֥וּ דַיּ֖וֹת אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh qin·nə·nāh qip·pō·wz wat·tə·mal·lêṭ ū·ḇā·qə·‘āh wə·ḏā·ḡə·rāh ḇə·ṣil·lāh ’aḵ- šām niq·bə·ṣū ḏay·yō·wṯ ’iš·šāh rə·‘ū·ṯāh
verses.literal: There the owl will make her nest she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow Even there the birds of prey will gather each with its mate
verses.literalPt: Ali, fará a serpente o seu ninho, porá os ovos e os chocará; e, debaixo da sua sombra, ajuntará os seus filhotes. Ali, se ajuntarão os abutres, macho e fêmea.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֨וּ מֵֽעַל־ סֵ֤פֶר יְהוָה֙ וּֽקְרָ֔אוּ אַחַ֤ת מֵהֵ֙נָּה֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔רָה אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א פָקָ֑דוּ כִּֽי־ פִי֙ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔ה וְרוּח֖וֹ ה֥וּא קִבְּצָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: dir·šū mê·‘al- sê·p̄er Yah·weh ū·qə·rā·’ū ’a·ḥaṯ mê·hên·nāh lō ne‘·dā·rāh ’iš·šāh rə·‘ū·ṯāh lō p̄ā·qā·ḏū kî- p̄î hū ṣiw·wāh wə·rū·ḥōw hū qib·bə·ṣān
verses.literal: Search . . . and read the scroll of the LORD Not one of these will go missing not one . . . will lack her mate because He has ordered it by His mouth and He will gather them by His Spirit
verses.literalPt: Buscai no livro de Jeová e lede; nenhuma dessas criaturas faltará, nenhuma será privada do seu companheiro, porque a boca de Jeová o ordenou, e o seu Espírito as ajuntou.

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִפִּ֤יל לָהֶן֙ גּוֹרָ֔ל וְיָד֛וֹ חִלְּקַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם בַּקָּ֑ו עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ יִֽירָשׁ֔וּהָ לְד֥וֹר וָד֖וֹר יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hip·pîl lā·hen gō·w·rāl wə·yā·ḏōw ḥil·lə·qat·tāh lā·hem baq·qāw ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām yî·rā·šū·hā lə·ḏō·wr wā·ḏō·wr yiš·kə·nū- ḇāh
verses.literal: He has allotted their portion His hand has distributed it by measure They will possess it forever . . . they will dwell in it from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: Ele deitou sortes por elas, e a sua mão lhes repartiu por medida esta terra; possuí-la-ão para sempre; de geração em geração, nela habitarão.
